pre_registration_note: This config defines the hybrid validator and prompt parameters used for the AAAI 2027 paper. Frozen on pat_test_01 (dev). Must not be modified once the 20 held-out cases begin.

llm_call.temperature_justification: 0.7 reflects realistic deployment defaults rather than a determinism-maximising 0.0 that would artificially suppress the reproducibility variance we are measuring.

guard_1_phantom_citation.rule: cited_document_id MUST appear in the set of document_ids for the patient

guard_2_trivial_quote.justification: A minimum of six words / thirty characters excludes single-term keyword matches while admitting any complete clinical phrase. The OR'd soft branch admits terse-but-grounded clinical instructions verified on the 13 dev-quote test.

guard_3_verbatim.rule: source_quote must appear verbatim in cited document; whitespace-normalised substring match; rejections sub-bucketed into case-mismatch / paraphrase-or-boundary / fabrication based on word-overlap fraction
guard_3_verbatim.normalisation: lowercase preserved (case-mismatch reported separately); whitespace collapsed via re.sub(r'\s+', ' '); leading/trailing strip

guard_4_irrelevant_padding.rule: quote must share at least one >=4-char alphabetic clinical subject word with the flag's category+description after stripping stopwords
guard_4_irrelevant_padding.justification: Closes the padding loophole - a long but irrelevant quote that satisfies guards 1-3 would still fail Guard 4 if it shares no clinical subject word with its own flag's description.

dataset_split.rule: Validator and prompt parameters frozen against pat_test_01. After the 20-case run begins, no further parameter adjustment is permitted.
